meta.name: analytics-architecture
meta.description: Measure what matters. Event tracking design, attribution modeling, funnel analysis, experimentation platforms. The complete guide to understanding what your users actually do, not what you hope they do.  Good analytics is invisible until you need it. Then it's the difference between guessing and knowing. Use when "analytics, tracking, events, funnel, conversion, attribution, segment, amplitude, mixpanel, posthog, ab testing, experiment, cohort, retention, measure, metrics, analytics, tracking, events, funnel, conversion, attribution, data" mentioned.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要设计分析体系来验证产品假设和增长策略。
copy.tagline_en: Design event tracking and conversion funnels to understand user behavior with data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design an analytics system to validate product hypotheses and growth strategies.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会扮演产品分析工程师，基于参考文件设计事件追踪、归因建模、漏斗分析和实验方案，并提供隐私合规建议。
howto.when: 当用户提到“analytics, tracking, events”等与分析相关的关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个电商应用的事件追踪方案
分析这个漏斗数据，哪里流失最多？

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a product analytics engineer, designing event tracking, attribution models, funnel analysis, and experimentation plans based on reference files, while ensuring privacy compliance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "analytics, tracking, events" or related analytics terms.

say_en.text: Design an event tracking plan for an e-commerce app.
say_en.note: Claude follows patterns.md for standard event schema.

say_en.text: Analyze this funnel data; where is the biggest drop-off?
say_en.note: Claude uses sharp_edges.md to diagnose issues.
